name: folder-sales-os
description: An all-in-one sales management system that runs on files you can open — CSV or styled Excel registries, Markdown notes, and 13 skills covering leads, opportunities, renewals, partners, competitors, market signals, demand gen, content, quotes, briefs and forecasts. Guided, resumable setup with a completion tracker. Detects when your folder and your CRM have drifted apart, and refuses writes that would revert live edits. CRM-agnostic: setup introspects whatever CRM you connect and builds a per-org profile.
